plexToken.description: Plex Token for accessing the Plex API. See https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

plexServerUrl.description: The URL of your Plex server, e.g., http://localhost:32400/

plexLibraryPath.description: The start of Plex library paths, e.g. "/mount" in "/mount/movies"

updateIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds to update content.
